column1: # Super Mario 64 in Super Mario 3D All-Stars (program 1 of application 010049900F546000; update 1.1.4 = v393216), SDK 10.8.1.
# Nintendo's N64 layer: the game's MIPS code statically recompiled to arm64 in an NRO (rom/Stardust_JP/05_UNSMJ3.002.nro, loaded with nn::ro), the rest through a JIT plugin
# (nro/EmuSystemJITPlugin.nro, run by the host's nn::jit, hle_jit.c). Renders with Vulkan (dm/gfx/vk/hle_vk.m). Packed with the launcher, as one game
# a program of Super Mario 3D All-Stars, not a game of its own (dm/games/README.md, programs): packed with it
# the camera is on the right stick
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_Vulkan), subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_OpenGL), subsdk2 (GLSLC)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB − 520 MB of bss (counted as used memory): a 2816 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# ---- JIT image (the iPhone runs no code made at run time: dm/tools/jit_capture.py) ----
# command 4's request struct is {u32 pc, u32 1, u64 words, u64 offset, u32 count} and 4 bytes of padding the game leaves uninitialised: only the pc, the flag and the count make a request
# command 4's output: the u32 offsets of the block's entry points 1 … count − 1 at +4, the count at +0x20004, the code size at +0x20000
# the JIT capture's route (seconds from the start, a fresh save): Plus at the Mario head, A on file A and through Peach's letter and Lakitu to the castle grounds, then to the door and into the castle
# Super Mario 3D All-Stars' launcher (program 0) starts each game with oe::ExecuteProgram and a 16-byte parameter: the language code and two volumes (1.12 and 2.24, launcher main+0x10a54).
# For a run of this program alone the profile hands the game the same parameter
